#hetamap barplot
```{r}
# heatmap barplot
# module composition barplot by truth module across cell numbers

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

# Step 0. IO

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_cell_number_4000g_6tp"

cm_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "module_confusion_matrix")
barplot_dir <- file.path(cm_dir, "truth_module_composition_barplot")

dir.create(barplot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cm_long_file <- file.path(
  cm_dir,
  "CM_module_truth_vs_pred_all_long.csv"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(cm_long_file))

CELL_NUMBER_ORDER <- c(600, 1500, 3000, 6000, 10500, 20000)
MODULE_LEVELS <- 0:7
MODULE_LABELS <- paste0("M", MODULE_LEVELS)

CELL_NUMBER_LABELS <- c(
  "600" = "600",
  "1500" = "1,500",
  "3000" = "3,000",
  "6000" = "6,000",
  "10500" = "10,500",
  "20000" = "20,000"
)

MODULE_COLORS <- c(
  "M0" = "#F7F5FA",
  "M1" = "#EAE6F2",
  "M2" = "#DCD5E8",
  "M3" = "#CFC3DD",
  "M4" = "#C1B2D2",
  "M5" = "#B5A3C6",
  "M6" = "#A895BA",
  "M7" = "#9B89AE"
)

# Step 1. Read confusion matrix long table

cm_long <- read_csv(cm_long_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

print(colnames(cm_long))
print(head(cm_long))

cm_long2 <- cm_long %>%
  rename_with(~ "Truth_num", matches("^Truth_num$|^truth_num$|^truth_module$|^Truth_module$")) %>%
  rename_with(~ "Pred_num", matches("^Pred_num$|^pred_num$|^pred_module$|^Pred_module$")) %>%
  rename_with(~ "Freq", matches("^Freq$|^freq$|^n$|^Count$|^count$")) %>%
  mutate(
    target_n_cell = as.integer(target_n_cell),
    repeat_id = as.integer(repeat_id),
    Truth_num = as.integer(Truth_num),
    Pred_num = as.integer(Pred_num),
    Freq = as.numeric(Freq)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Truth_num %in% MODULE_LEVELS,
    Pred_num %in% MODULE_LEVELS,
    target_n_cell %in% CELL_NUMBER_ORDER
  )

stopifnot(
  all(c("target_n_cell", "repeat_id", "Truth_num", "Pred_num", "Freq") %in% colnames(cm_long2))
)

# Step 2. Calculate predicted composition within each ground-truth module

composition_count <- cm_long2 %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell, Truth_num, Pred_num) %>%
  summarise(
    Freq = sum(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    target_n_cell = CELL_NUMBER_ORDER,
    Truth_num = MODULE_LEVELS,
    Pred_num = MODULE_LEVELS,
    fill = list(Freq = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell, Truth_num) %>%
  mutate(
    Truth_total = sum(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent = ifelse(Truth_total > 0, Freq / Truth_total * 100, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    target_n_cell = factor(target_n_cell, levels = CELL_NUMBER_ORDER),
    Truth_label = factor(paste0("M", Truth_num), levels = MODULE_LABELS),
    Pred_label = factor(paste0("M", Pred_num), levels = MODULE_LABELS),
    label = ifelse(Percent >= 3, sprintf("%.1f%%", Percent), "")
  )

check_sum <- composition_count %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell, Truth_num) %>%
  summarise(
    total_percent = sum(Percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_count = sum(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(check_sum)

stopifnot(all(abs(check_sum$total_percent - 100) < 1e-6))

write_csv(
  composition_count,
  file.path(barplot_dir, "truth_module_predicted_composition_long.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  composition_count,
  file.path(barplot_dir, "truth_module_predicted_composition_long.rds")
)

# Step 3. Plot one stacked barplot per truth module

plot_one_truth_module <- function(module_id) {
  module_label <- paste0("M", module_id)

  df_plot <- composition_count %>%
    filter(Truth_num == module_id) %>%
    mutate(
      target_n_cell = factor(as.character(target_n_cell), levels = as.character(CELL_NUMBER_ORDER)),
      Pred_label = factor(as.character(Pred_label), levels = MODULE_LABELS)
    )

  stopifnot(nrow(df_plot) > 0)

  check_plot <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(target_n_cell) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(Percent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  stopifnot(all(abs(check_plot$total - 100) < 1e-6))

  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(x = target_n_cell, y = Freq, fill = Pred_label)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = "fill",
      width = 0.72,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 5.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "serif",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = CELL_NUMBER_LABELS
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = MODULE_COLORS,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Predicted module"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = module_label,
      x = "Number of cells",
      y = "Proportion (%)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 28),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17, colour = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(barplot_dir, paste0("Truth_", module_label, "_predicted_composition_barplot.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(barplot_dir, paste0("Truth_", module_label, "_predicted_composition_barplot.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )

  p
}

p_list <- list()

for (module_id in MODULE_LEVELS) {
  message("Plotting truth module composition barplot | M", module_id)
  p_list[[paste0("M", module_id)]] <- plot_one_truth_module(module_id)
}

# Step 4. Save compact summary of correct proportion only

correct_prop_df <- composition_count %>%
  filter(Truth_num == Pred_num) %>%
  transmute(
    target_n_cell,
    truth_module = Truth_label,
    correct_count = Freq,
    truth_total = Truth_total,
    correct_percent = Percent
  ) %>%
  arrange(truth_module, as.numeric(as.character(target_n_cell)))

write_csv(
  correct_prop_df,
  file.path(barplot_dir, "truth_module_correct_proportion_summary.csv")
)

print(correct_prop_df)

message("Finished truth-module composition barplots.")
message("Output: ", barplot_dir)
```
